provenance.paper_title: Dual Latent Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Curator, seeker, condenser, and weaver manage latent experience for VLA reasoning.
During operation, LaMem-VLA applies a trained but frozen update module to short- and long-term latent vaults; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
The condenser compacts retrieved evidence. For LaMem-VLA, this specifically supports merging or deduplication of overlapping entries of short- and long-term latent vaults.
During operation, LaMem-VLA applies explicit deletion or eviction of stored items to short- and long-term latent vaults; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (short- and long-term latent vaults) changes through a trained but frozen update module, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
